definitions.gloss: at-bat, plate appearance, turn at bat
definitions.explanation: A batter's turn to face the pitcher in baseball. Also refers to the batter's box area where the batter stands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧4{打席|だせき}3⟦{安打|あんだ}→安打：19717_anda⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He went 3 for 4 (3 hits in 4 at-bats) today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧{打席|だせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: He hit a home run in his first at-bat.

examples.japanese: {打席|だせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{素振|すぶ}り→素振り：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He took some practice swings before stepping up to the plate.

notes:
RELATED BASEBALL STATISTICS:
- ⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧ (batting average)
- ⟦{打数|だすう}→打数：29966_dasuu⟧ (at-bats, official at-bats excluding walks/hit-by-pitch)
- ⟦{安打|あんだ}→安打：19717_anda⟧ (hit)
- ⟦{打点|だてん}→打点：08589_daten⟧ (RBI, runs batted in)

NOTE ON {打席|だせき} vs ⟦{打数|だすう}→打数：29966_dasuu⟧:
- {打席|だせき} (plate appearance) - all turns at bat
- ⟦{打数|だすう}→打数：29966_dasuu⟧ (at-bat) - excludes walks, sacrifices, hit-by-pitch
- ⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧ is calculated using ⟦{打数|だすう}→打数：29966_dasuu⟧, not {打席|だせき}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {打席|だせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to step up to the plate)
- {打席|だせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand at bat)
- ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧{打席|だせき} (first at-bat)
- ⟦{代打|だいだ}→代打：19621_daida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打席|だせき} (pinch-hitter's at-bat)
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{打席|だせき}⟦{出塁|しゅつるい}→出塁：09486_shutsurui⟧ (consecutive plate appearances reaching base)
